briefing: Markets were quietly positive today (NASDAQ +0.5%, S&P 500 +0.2%) without a strong risk-on signal, so rather than deploying cash broadly we picked two fully-confirmed, diversifying candidates — Talen Energy (power/AI-demand theme) and Revvity (life sciences) — each showing all five bullish technical signals. Existing positions are held unchanged since nothing warrants an exit on a neutral day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means only acting on a buy signal when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price versus moving average, and trading volume — all agree at once. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when five line up together it's a much stronger sign that real buying interest (often institutional) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量確認是指只有在多個獨立指標（如RSI、MACD、股價相對移動平均線、以及成交量）同時一致發出訊號時才採取買入行動。單一看漲訊號可能只是noise，但當五項指標同時齊備時，就更有力地顯示背後有真實（甚至是機構）買盤支持。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today with NASDAQ up 0.5% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, a continuation of the low-volatility grind higher rather than a sharp catalyst-driven move. No single headline-driving event stood out, consistent with a market digesting recent gains. Breadth among growth and cyclical names remained constructive, which is why several individual stocks screened with strong multi-signal technical setups even as the broad index moves were muted.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和向上，納指上升0.5%，標普500則升0.2%，延續近期低波幅穩步向上的格局，並無明顯重大消息推動。市場似乎在消化先前升幅，整體氣氛審慎樂觀。雖然大盤指數變動輕微，但個別增長股及周期股的廣度仍然良好，部分股份因此錄得多項技術指標同步轉強。

trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 66.2 bullish zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) plus structural AI power-demand tailwind diversifies away from existing tech/semi exposure.
